provenance: Unchanged authored GDAL test fixtures. The edge archive holds two invented road lines and two invented areas. The single world tile holds four city point records with fixture/historical attribute values and two invented polygons; it is not a current place dataset. Source coordinates are design inputs, not measurements. Neither fixture contains encoded feature IDs.
